panel.name: Tau Companion
panel.pinHint: Pin panel: keep open when switching tabs
panel.library: View this page in the companion library
panel.hide: Hide the companion on this site
pair.title: Confirm the connection in Tau
pair.hint: Tau has opened an authorization window. Check that the code matches, then select Allow. You only need to do this once.
pair.running: Check that Tau is running and up to date
pair.accept: Enable Accept new connection requests in Tau › Settings › Browser extension
pair.cooldown: After repeated denials, wait 10 minutes before trying again
connect.title: Connecting to Tau…
connect.soon: This should only take a moment.
launch.title: Waiting for Tau…
launch.hint: If the browser asks to open Tau, select Open. Chat will appear once connected.
launch.confirm: Authorize the first connection in Tau
offline.title: Connect to Tau to start chatting
offline.hint: Check that the latest Tau is installed and allow the browser to open it. You can also open Tau manually and check again.
denied.title: Tau denied the connection
denied.body: If this was accidental, send another request.
revoked.title: Authorization revoked in Tau
revoked.body: Local annotations and notes are kept and will sync when reconnected.
closed.title: Tau is not accepting new connections
closed.body: Enable Accept new connection requests in Tau › Settings › Browser extension, then try again.
throttled.title: Too many requests
throttled.body: Wait a little before trying again after repeated denials.
missing.title: Tau was not found
missing.body: Chat uses the models configured in Tau. Open Tau to connect automatically. Annotations and notes remain available and will sync when connected.
